items.title: AIR
items.summary: AIR is an experimental C++20 AI inference runtime from Superior MI Labs focused on explicit state ownership, bounded scheduling, GGUF execution, CUDA, and evidence-driven R&D.
items.summary_cn: AIR是Superior MI Labs的实验性C + +20 AI推理运行时，专注于显式状态所有权、有界调度、GGUF执行、CUDA和循证驱动的研发。
items.comment: AI 领域新动态，保持关注，别被营销号带节奏。

items.title: Boltzmann-Machine
items.summary: A simple Boltzmann Machine built from scratch with NumPy to explore energy-based learning, stochastic neurons, and probability.
items.summary_cn: 使用NumPy从头开始构建的简单玻尔兹曼机器，用于探索基于能量的学习、随机神经元和概率。
items.comment: 监管落地对行业是双刃剑，合规成本飙升，小玩家可能被挤出市场。

items.title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning

items.title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
items.title_cn: Anthropic的招股说明书详细说明了亏损、增长，以及，是的，关于其人工智能可能会终结人类的警告
items.summary: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.
items.summary_cn: 在其招股说明书中， Anthropic刚刚告诉投资者，它每年损失数百亿美元，但也在疯狂增长，而且—哦，是的—它自己的人工智能可能对人类构成生存风险。
items.comment: 新趋势值得注意，别盲目跟风，适合自己的才是最好的。

items.title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
items.title_cn: 据报道， OpenAI因安全问题而放弃了模型
